sources.title: Zero-Shot Transfer: Definition & AI Applications
sources.snippet: Zero-shot transfer is a model's ability to perform a new task without specific training data, using natural language prompts. Learn its mechanisms and applications.

sources.title: Zero-shot learning - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Zero-shot learning (ZSL) is a problem setup in machine learning where, at test time, a learner observes samples from classes which were not observed during training, and needs to predict their class. The name is a play on words based on the earlier concept of one-shot learning in computer vision, in which classification can be learned from only one example.
